english.title: Producer of novel tobacco product fail to submit new info re toxicity / risks / effects etc. of product
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the producer of a novel tobacco product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..), failed to submit to the Secretary of State on or before the 20th May that followed the information becoming available, new or updated information on the matters referred to in regulation 22(2)(e) to (g) of the Tobacco and Related Products Regulations 2016, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE NEW / UPDATED INFORMATION..), which had become available to you after you had notified the product
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 24(c), 48(b) and 51 of the Tobacco and Related Products Regulations 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
producer of novel tobacco product
failed to submit to Secretary of State
new / updated r22(2)(e) to (g) information
which had become available after product notification

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) In any proceedings for an offence under these Regulations brought against a person who supplies any tobacco product or related product in breach of these Regulations, it is a defence that the supplier exercised all due diligence to avoid committing the offence.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None
